label: PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY
definition: best deliverable total flow [mg/s] at the feed for every P_req of the sweep with ONE setpoint for all five F1 orbit states: max over admissible P_set >= P_req on the grid of the minimum over the states (every state in domain and feasible); null = no admissible P_set. Rows without any feasible P_req are omitted (their reasons are in the main JSON reason_histogram)
